item.title: Taylor Fresh Foods Inc: Spicy Pimento Cheese Dip. Recall
item.summary: Potential contamination with Salmonella. Product details: Spicy Pimento Cheese Dip. Ingredients: Sharp Cheddar Cheese *** Cream Cheese *** Piquillo Peppers *** Jalapeno Pepper, Mayonnaise *** Cayenne Pepper Sauce *** Dijon Mustard *** Granulated Garlic, Cayenne Pepper, Pimiento Peppers *** Net Wt: 10 oz. Keep Refrige...
item.affectedPeople: Domestic: AL, AR, FL, GA, IL, IN, KS, KY, LA, MA, ME, MI, MN, MO, MS, NC, NE, NH, NY, OH, OK, SC, TN, TX, VT, WI, WV. Foreign: Not applicable.
item.remedy: Affected quantity: Kentucky: 421 units; Texas: 56,028 units
item.payoutAmount: Refund, replacement, correction, or disposal if stated by the official notice
